Tom Pl You're mistaken. It won't be accepted as a justification—it'll likely be used against you. I'd be happy to be wrong, but there are plenty of cases like this.
  If the stay abroad is part of the job requirement and you're traveling together, be prepared that they'll likely argue your center of life is abroad. If you're living separately because of the job, that's an even stronger basis for refusal because of the lack of a shared life.
